lines.text: Something big and orange bubbles in the middle of the room. It glorps.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Blorp! A visitor! Nobody comes down here.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: I'm Kyle. I keep the furnace warm.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Don't touch me. I'm very hot. I'm also very busy.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: I heard about you up there. Stay away from my furnace.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: You again! The furnace nearly went out last time!

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Glorp! You're letting the cold in!
You shovel coal into the furnace. The blob jiggles happily.
You open the old vent. Warm air rushes up to the town.
You pat the blob very quickly. It's warm, like a bath.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Blorp. Nobody ever pats me.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Hot! Hot! Everything is hot!

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Stop running! You're making me bubble!

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Glorp! My drips are going everywhere!

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: I'm melting! Wait. I'm always melting.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: The furnace is toasty. The whole town will be warm till morning. Blorp!

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Here. A pebble from the middle of me. It stays warm all night.
You got a warm pebble.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Fine. I'll keep the furnace warm by myself. Glorp.
Kyle oozes into the furnace and shuts the door.

lines.speaker: lava_blob
lines.text: Still toasty. Thanks for the pat. Blorp.
A pool of bubbling lava. A bubble pops and says blorp.
A small lava puddle. It's the blob's bath.
An old copper pipe. It's warm, and it hums. It goes up to every house in town.
